text:
maria.g: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — consolidating action items and owners. main goals: reduce timeouts, eliminate partial responses, and harden reconnect logic. link to postmortem: <https://redwood.internal/wiki/postmortems/INF-2345|postmortem>
ajay.k: Ack. Do we want to split short-term quick fixes vs longer platform changes? I can own tests and canary orchestration.
samuel: I can own the server-side reconnect/backoff changes (handshake retry, kv-cache invalidation). ETA: Fri 2026-03-27 EOD.
leo_p: I’ll take SDK client changes — graceful close, adaptive backoff, and updating examples. ETA: Mon 2026-03-30.
taylor: I'll add telemetry for partial-chunk detection and last-token latency. PR for schema by Wed.
oncall-bot: Incident INF-2345 marked resolved. Postmortem published by maria.g :white_check_mark:
maria.g: Timeline proposal: samuel finishes server patch Fri -> canary Sat (small cohort) -> monitor 48h -> gradual rollout Mon. Objections?
ajay.k: Sounds good. I'll get the canary playbook ready. Also adding regression harness for tiny batch streaming and reconnect edgecases.
samuel: One blocker: handshake timeout default. Current default is 1500ms in runtime; I propose 2500ms with client-side adaptive backoff. Thoughts?
leo_p: 2500ms + exponential jitter seems safer for flaky networks. SDK will add adaptive window so we can reduce server pressure.
taylor: Telemetry fields I'll add: "partial_chunk": boolean, "last_token_ts": iso8601, "handshake_ms": integer. Also synthetic-sessions metric every 5m.
maria.g: Ownership table (for clarity): server reconnect/backoff -> samuel; sdk backoff & graceful close -> leo_p; tests & canary -> ajay.k; telemetry & alerts -> taylor. I'll track in the ticket.
samuel: I'll open PR titled "reconnect/kv-cache-invalidations" and attach unit + integration tests. Will link in this thread when ready.
ajay.k: Tests: I'll write harness to replay recorded sessions (includes partial streams) and assert full-response within 30s. ETA Tue. Will add to CI as flaky gated job initially.
leo_p: SDK changelog update planned. Will bump minor version and post migration notes for customers.
taylor: Alerting thresholds proposed: partial_rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m -> paged to streaming-oncall; handshake_5xx_rate increase 3x in 10m -> page.
maria.g: Recurring work: run weekly triage on streaming incidents for 4 weeks post-rollout. eng-rotation-bot, please schedule.
eng-rotation-bot: Reminder set: "Streaming incident triage" weekly, Mondays 10:00am, starting next Monday.
ajay.k: Question: should we fallback to an alternate lighter model when we detect repeated partials / timeouts for a user session?
samuel: Not in immediate plan — that’s an ops-level model-variant fallback we can schedule Q2. Short-term: focus on reconnect/backoff + telemetry.
maria.g: JIRA created: INF-2345 (server reconnect), INF-2346 (SDK backoff), INF-2347 (telemetry+alerts), INF-2348 (regression harness/canary). Owners assigned in tickets.
leo_p: I'll pair with samuel on handshake unit tests — we should test simultaneous kv-cache invalidation + reconnect loop.
taylor: Adding a synthetic check snippet for teams to run locally:
```bash
# reproduce partial stream locally
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \n  "https://api.redwood.dev/v1/stream?model=chat-lite" | sed -n '1,20p'
```
maria.g: Rollout guardrails: PRs merged -> canary -> observed stable for 48h -> gradual 10% -> 50% -> full. If partial_rate spikes at any stage, rollback and investigate.
samuel: Starting work now, will post PR link by EOD. If I hit infra quota for staging GPUs I'll call it out here.
ajay.k: I'll schedule the canary window and invite SRE to monitor infra metrics. tagging @sre on the canary day.
leo_p: Small note: update SDK retry doc to show code example and recommended backoff params. I’ll post draft.
taylor: I'll create a dashboard tile: "Partial stream rate (per route)" and make it editable for each product team.
maria.g: Closing checklist for this thread: 1) update runbook, 2) open PRs, 3) run canary, 4) monitor 48h, 5) post-canary retro. I'll post daily status updates here until everything is green.
ajay.k: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
samuel: PR link: https://git.redwood.internal/r/reconnect/+/1234 (WIP) - tests failing on handshake timeout case, investigating.
maria.g: Thanks — please ping here when tests pass. We'll reconvene if anything slips.
